items.title: NCAA Commitee On Infractions Classifies Alabama State Case As Mitigated - Alabama State University Athletics
items.summary:
ASU agreed that a former Sports Information Director altered one student-athlete's competition statistics during the 2019 season on the institution's athletics website, allegedly at the direction of the former head football coach. The matter involved the conduct of a single employee and did not involve any allegation of a lack of institutional control or failure to monitor. [...] ### Story Links

MONTGOMERY, Ala. | Alabama State University has received the NCAA Division I Committee on Infractions' public infractions decision classifying its case as Level I-Mitigated. ASU accepts the decision and recognizes the panel for its consideration of the record. The Committee prescribed the minimum financial penalty of $30,000 plus one percent of the football program budget and three years of probation. [...] "This outcome reflects a significant disparity," said Ross. The certifying institution received a minor infraction, while Alabama State was assigned one of the NCAA's most serious classifications. We believe the standards should be applied consistently across all institutions, and this case underscores the importance of fairness and accountability throughout the NCAA governance process.

items.title: Saudi Arabia, US carry out strikes on Iran-backed groups in ...
items.summary:
Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi is expected to travel to Saudi Arabia on Thursday, days after he ordered Iraqi security agencies to investigate the drone attacks on Saudi Arabia.

“Iraq is committed to preventing Iraqi territory from being used as a route or launching point for any attack targeting brotherly or friendly countries,” the Iraqi military said in a statement on Monday. [...] Screen grab from July 25, 2026 from undated UGC video posted on social media and verified by AFPTV shows clouds of smoke rising after strikes on the Saudi Aramco refinery in Jizan [AFP]



By Al Jazeera Staff and Reuters

Published On 29 Jul 202629 Jul 2026

Saudi Arabia has carried out targeted strikes against Iran-backed armed groups in Iraq, in coordination with US Central Command (CENTCOM), according to a statement released by the Saudi Ministry of Defence. [...] The Islamic Resistance in Iraq, an umbrella group of Iran-backed armed groups, denied any role in the attacks, saying the Saudi claims were “fabrications” and that “any foolish Saudi action will be met with a harsh response”.
